fullPassage:
Continuous emissions measurement can be costly, particularly where there are many separate sources of emissions, and for many pollution problems this may be a major disincentive to direct taxation of emissions.

Environmental taxes based directly on measured emissions can, in principle, be very precisely targeted to the policy's environmental objectives. ( ① ) If a firm pollutes more, it pays additional tax directly in proportion to the rise in emissions. ( ② ) The polluter thus has an incentive to reduce emissions in any manner that is less costly per unit of abatement than the tax on each unit of residual emissions. ( ③ ) The great attraction of basing the tax directly on measured emissions is that the actions the polluter can take to reduce tax liability are actions that also reduce emissions. ( ④ ) Nevertheless, the technologies available for monitoring the concentrations and flows of particular substances in waste discharges have been developing rapidly. ( ⑤ ) In the future, it may be possible to think of taxing measured emissions in a wider range of applications.

questions.passage: Continuous emissions measurement can be ①<u>costly</u>, particularly where there are many separate sources of emissions. Environmental taxes ②<u>basing</u> directly on measured emissions can, in principle, be very precisely targeted to the policy's environmental objectives. If a firm pollutes more, it pays additional tax directly in ③<u>proportion</u> to the rise in emissions. The polluter thus has an ④<u>incentive</u> to reduce emissions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② basing(능동)은 based(수동)로 바꿔야 한다. 세금이 '기반되는(based on)' 수동 관계.
det.analysis:
❌ ② basing → based: taxes가 기반'되는' 수동 관계 (p.p.)
✅ ① costly: be + 형용사 (정상)
✅ ③ proportion: in proportion to 전치사구 (정상)
✅ ④ incentive: 명사 (정상)
det.tip: based on(~에 기반한) — 과거분사 수동 형용사

The great attraction of ②<u>base</u> the tax directly on measured emissions is that the actions the polluter can take to reduce tax liability are actions that also reduce emissions. Nevertheless, the technologies available for ③<u>monitoring</u> the concentrations and flows of particular substances have been ④<u>developing</u> rapidly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② base(동사원형)는 basing(동명사)으로 바꿔야 한다. 전치사 of + 동명사 구조.
det.analysis:
❌ ② base → basing: of + 동명사 (the attraction of basing)
✅ ① reduce: to + 동사원형 (정상)
✅ ③ monitoring: for + 동명사 (정상)
✅ ④ developing: have been + ~ing 현재완료진행 (정상)
det.tip: of + 동명사: the attraction of basing (기반하는 것의 매력)
